capabilities: capture a photo from the device camera and embed it at the cursor
preview and retake desktop shots before inserting
pick an existing image and embed it the same way
send photos to a configurable folder and follow wikilink or Markdown link settings
run the capture as a command assignable to a hotkey or the mobile toolbar
extras: Documents platform limitations: macOS Obsidian lacks Apple's camera entitlement so live capture falls back to Choose a photo, and the Linux Flatpak needs camera access granted via Flatseal. Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. States no network requests and no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to take a photo and insert it where you are typing; you have to shoot outside the app and then import and embed the file manually.
summary: Camera capture tool that takes a photo with the device camera from the editor context menu and embeds it at the cursor.
